title: The Day Before
info-one: Have an iron-rich diet such as beans, spinach or meat, poultry.
info-two: Have a proper sleep of at least 8 hours
info-three: Include more liquids in your diet

title: On the Donation day
info-one: Do carry your identify identification forms e.g. driver’s license
info-two: Drink 2 cups of water before donating blood
info-three: Wear a half sleeve shirt so that you can easily roll it up avoid fast food before donation

title: After the Donation
info-one: Reward yourself with a snack as refreshment immediately.
info-two: Drink more liquids over a period of 24 hours
info-three: Remove the bandage after few hours
